items.title: CLARITY Act's delay is 'depressing': Coinbase exec. discusses
items.summary: Coinbase's (COIN) head of institutional strategy, John D'Agostino, joins Yahoo Executive Editor Brian Sozzi on Opening Bid to discuss the stalled CLARITY Act, why the legislation matters for the crypto industry, and the growing role of stablecoins. D'Agostino also states that political stalling is holding up the bill, and why the delay is "depressing."

items.title: Why Coinbase (COIN) Stock Is Falling Today
items.summary: Shares of blockchain infrastructure company Coinbase (NASDAQ:COIN) fell 3.1% in the morning session after a broad crypto market downturn prompted by a hawkish monetary outlook from the Bank of Japan and escalating geopolitical risks. The crypto market came under pressure following reports that Japan's central bank was planning to raise interest rates.
